0022600113.text: The Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 1 game back) visit the Brooklyn Nets (0-1, 10th in the East, 4th in the Atlantic and 2 games back) after dropping their last game. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and is a game-time decision, and Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Indiana won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 123-94 win in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026.
